name_en: Parametric prefrontal beta-band power during working memory retention
name_zh: 工作记忆保持期前额叶β功率的参数调制
reason: During retention in the vibrotactile two-interval comparison task, beta (20-25 Hz) power over the inferior frontal gyrus scales with the remembered frequency and predicts discrimination (Spitzer et al. 2010, doi:10.1523/JNEUROSCI.6041-09.2010; MEG replication von Lautz et al. 2017, doi:10.3389/fnhum.2017.00576). No registry marker covers this readout; MEM-VTWM-001 temporarily uses MK.SSSEP (stimulus-locked S1 response) and MK.BOLD_frontoparietal. Maintainer to decide whether visual and auditory parametric WM versions should share the marker (curator_d, sprint 7, 2026-10-17).
